title: Integrate Phase 2 components, state, navigation, and persistence
acceptance_criteria: App startup loads the migrated storage state once and all Phase 2 views share the same current routines, schedule, and reminder settings.
Navigation exposes routine management, weekly schedule editing, and reminder settings without breaking the existing exercise library or routine builder.
Saving, selecting, renaming, deleting, scheduling, and reminder changes remain visible after reload and do not overwrite unrelated local data.
All user-facing copy is English, semantic controls have labels/focus states, and unsupported notification fallback remains visible where relevant.
Existing build and lint behavior remains passing after integration.
completion_summary: Integrated the migrated shared storage state with Dashboard, Exercise Library, Routine Builder, Saved Routines, Schedule, and Reminders views. Persistence, responsive styling, accessibility focus states, and shared routine/schedule/reminder updates are wired; lint, build, and tests pass.
